Andhra Pradesh Approves Pooled Municipal Bond Framework Worth Over ₹1000 Crore

The Andhra Pradesh government has approved a pooled municipal bond framework valued at over ₹1000 crore. This initiative aims to finance development projects across multiple municipalities within the state. The framework is expected to facilitate easier access to capital for local governance bodies.
